description: This file contains utility functions for managing QConfig mappings in PyTorch's quantization framework using FX graph modules. It includes functions for adjusting configurations based on module fusion, matching configurations to modules or functions, validating configuration consistency, and supporting quantization-aware training (QAT).

methods.name: QConfigAny _maybe_adjust_qconfig_for_module_name_object_type_order( qconfig_mapping: QConfigMapping, cur_module_path: str, cur_object_type: Callable, cur_object_type_idx: int, fallback_qconfig: QConfigAny, )
methods.description: Returns a specific QConfig from module name, object type, and index order, or fallback if not found.

methods.name: _update_qconfig_for_fusion(model: GraphModule, qconfig_mapping: QConfigMapping)
methods.description: Updates the QConfigMapping to account for fused modules like LinearReLU, ensuring consistent QConfig application post-fusion.

methods.name: dict[str,QConfigAny] _generate_node_name_to_qconfig( root: torch.nn.Module, modules: dict[str, torch.nn.Module], input_graph: Graph, qconfig_mapping: QConfigMapping, node_name_to_scope: dict[str, tuple[str, type]], )
methods.description: Generates a mapping from node names to their associated QConfig objects based on the FX graph, modules, and current QConfigMapping.

methods.name: None _check_is_valid_config_dict( config_dict: Any, allowed_keys: set[str], dict_name: str )
methods.description: Validates that the provided config dictionary contains only allowed keys.

methods.name: _compare_prepare_convert_qconfig_mappings( prepare_qconfig_mapping: QConfigMapping, convert_qconfig_mapping: QConfigMapping )
methods.description: Ensures the QConfig mappings used in prepare and convert steps for quantization are consistent and compatible.

methods.name: _is_qconfig_supported_by_dtype_configs( qconfig: QConfig, dtype_configs: list[DTypeConfig] )
methods.description: Checks if a given QConfig is supported by a list of data type configurations.

methods.name: QConfigAny _get_object_type_qconfig( qconfig_mapping: QConfigMapping, object_type: Callable | str, fallback_qconfig: QConfigAny, )
methods.description: Retrieves the QConfig for a specific object type, using a fallback if needed.

methods.name: _get_module_name_regex_qconfig(qconfig_mapping, module_name, fallback_qconfig)
methods.description: Returns the QConfig for a module name matched by regex patterns in the qconfig_mapping.

methods.name: _get_module_name_qconfig(qconfig_mapping, module_name, fallback_qconfig)
methods.description: Retrieves the QConfig associated with a module name, considering parent modules if needed.

methods.name: _maybe_adjust_qconfig_for_module_type_or_name( qconfig_mapping, module_type, module_name, global_qconfig )
methods.description: Determines the appropriate QConfig for a module based on its type, name, and global fallback.

methods.name: dict[Callable|str,QConfigAny] _get_flattened_qconfig_dict( qconfig_mapping: QConfigMapping, )
methods.description: Flattens the global, object_type, and module_name QConfigs into a single dictionary for propagation.

methods.name: _update_qconfig_for_qat( qconfig_mapping: QConfigMapping, backend_config: BackendConfig )
methods.description: Updates a QConfigMapping for quantization-aware training by replacing modules with QAT-specific modules based on backend config.
